title: Open Roll 5e: Combat Plus
description: Combat chores automated, each behind its own setting: combat music that hands back to what was playing, an initiative gate, a confirm before Reset Initiative, an out-of-turn movement block, defeated marking at 0 HP, player turn messages and sounds, target clearing, follow-the-combatant, a confirm before roll visibility changes, a portrait view for players (double-clicking a hostile creature, or any token they have no permission on, shows its portrait and name), and a GM Vision mode that brightens the scene, lifts the fog and shows every token to the GM.
